div.div: مُصَرَّاةٌ That has been left unmilked for some days, in order that the milk may collect in her udder, or until it has collected in her udder; (M, K;) as also ↓ صَرَّةٌ ; applied to a ewe, or she-goat: or the former is from صَرَّى, aor. يُصَرِّى, (K,) inf. n. تَصْرِيَةٌ, and therefore should be mentioned in art. صرى [q. v.]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
